meta.title: Negotiation
meta.description: No one ever wants to have a gun pointed at them, but circumstances can dictate otherwise.

units.rawText: I hear a series of mechanical transforming noises, followed immediately by the sight of countless glowing gun barrels before me.
units.displayText: I hear a series of mechanical transforming noises, followed immediately by the sight of countless glowing gun barrels before me.

spans.text: I hear a series of mechanical transforming noises, followed immediately by the sight of countless glowing gun barrels before me.

units.rawText: However, they do not attack. They simply take aim at me.
units.displayText: However, they do not attack. They simply take aim at me.

spans.text: However, they do not attack. They simply take aim at me.

units.rawText: I take this opportunity to think as fast as I can, trying to sort out my confused thoughts and make sense of the situation.
units.displayText: I take this opportunity to think as fast as I can, trying to sort out my confused thoughts and make sense of the situation.

spans.text: I take this opportunity to think as fast as I can, trying to sort out my confused thoughts and make sense of the situation.
Threat analysis.

options.rawText: Check on Persicaria and the others.
options.displayText: Check on Persicaria and the others.

spans.text: Check on Persicaria and the others.

units.rawText: There are five Sanctifiers surrounding me, an elite Sanctifier squad formation. Four of them, Lesser Sanctifiers, are pointing their guns at me.
units.displayText: There are five Sanctifiers surrounding me, an elite Sanctifier squad formation. Four of them, Lesser Sanctifiers, are pointing their guns at me.

spans.text: There are five Sanctifiers surrounding me, an elite Sanctifier squad formation. Four of them, Lesser Sanctifiers, are pointing their guns at me.

units.rawText: Behind them is an Intermediate Sanctifier. There are combat logs involving her. She is of the same grade as Faith, whom we met in Rossum.
units.displayText: Behind them is an Intermediate Sanctifier. There are combat logs involving her. She is of the same grade as Faith, whom we met in Rossum.

spans.text: Behind them is an Intermediate Sanctifier. There are combat logs involving her. She is of the same grade as Faith, whom we met in Rossum.

units.rawText: The sniper rifle she is holding left a deep impression on the Exiles who encountered her.
units.displayText: The sniper rifle she is holding left a deep impression on the Exiles who encountered her.

spans.text: The sniper rifle she is holding left a deep impression on the Exiles who encountered her.

units.rawText: If I'm not mistaken, her codename should be "Wisdom."
units.displayText: If I'm not mistaken, her codename should be "Wisdom."

spans.text: If I'm not mistaken, her codename should be "Wisdom."

units.rawText: I try my best to scan my surroundings without moving, and I can see Persicaria lying on the ground not far from me. Her wounds seem to have received basic treatment.
units.displayText: I try my best to scan my surroundings without moving, and I can see Persicaria lying on the ground not far from me. Her wounds seem to have received basic treatment.

spans.text: I try my best to scan my surroundings without moving, and I can see Persicaria lying on the ground not far from me. Her wounds seem to have received basic treatment.

units.rawText: I can sense that her neural cloud is still active, but she has not awakened yet. My guess is she is in the same state that I was in previously.
units.displayText: I can sense that her neural cloud is still active, but she has not awakened yet. My guess is she is in the same state that I was in previously.

spans.text: I can sense that her neural cloud is still active, but she has not awakened yet. My guess is she is in the same state that I was in previously.

units.rawText: Though I'm very worried about her, I can't make any careless moves right now.
units.displayText: Though I'm very worried about her, I can't make any careless moves right now.

spans.text: Though I'm very worried about her, I can't make any careless moves right now.

units.rawText: The others should be in roughly the same condition.
units.displayText: The others should be in roughly the same condition.

spans.text: The others should be in roughly the same condition.

options.rawText: Theorize as to why the Sanctifiers have not yet attacked me.
options.displayText: Theorize as to why the Sanctifiers have not yet attacked me.

spans.text: Theorize as to why the Sanctifiers have not yet attacked me.

options.rawText: Consider the possibility of armed resistance.
options.displayText: Consider the possibility of armed resistance.

spans.text: Consider the possibility of armed resistance.

units.rawText: There are only four Lesser Sanctifiers with their guns trained on me, while "Wisdom", the intermediate Sanctifier, displays no hostility towards me.
units.displayText: There are only four Lesser Sanctifiers with their guns trained on me, while "Wisdom", the intermediate Sanctifier, displays no hostility towards me.

spans.text: There are only four Lesser Sanctifiers with their guns trained on me, while "Wisdom", the intermediate Sanctifier, displays no hostility towards me.

units.rawText: According to our intelligence, Lesser Sanctifiers can only make the simplest logic decisions.
units.displayText: According to our intelligence, Lesser Sanctifiers can only make the simplest logic decisions.

spans.text: According to our intelligence, Lesser Sanctifiers can only make the simplest logic decisions.

units.rawText: Normally, they would attack me right away, since I have been identified as an Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: Normally, they would attack me right away, since I have been identified as an Irregular Agent.

spans.text: Normally, they would attack me right away, since I have been identified as an Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: In other words, "Wisdom" has ordered them to cease fire.
units.displayText: In other words, "Wisdom" has ordered them to cease fire.

spans.text: In other words, "Wisdom" has ordered them to cease fire.

units.rawText: Given the battle damage that these Lesser Sanctifiers have sustained, they have just been through combat and are not in an optimal state.
units.displayText: Given the battle damage that these Lesser Sanctifiers have sustained, they have just been through combat and are not in an optimal state.

spans.text: Given the battle damage that these Lesser Sanctifiers have sustained, they have just been through combat and are not in an optimal state.

units.rawText: While I could summon up operands to try and escape, I doubt I can get out in one piece when going up against Sanctifiers of this caliber.
units.displayText: While I could summon up operands to try and escape, I doubt I can get out in one piece when going up against Sanctifiers of this caliber.

spans.text: While I could summon up operands to try and escape, I doubt I can get out in one piece when going up against Sanctifiers of this caliber.

units.rawText: More to the point, I can't just abandon Persicaria and the others here.
units.displayText: More to the point, I can't just abandon Persicaria and the others here.

spans.text: More to the point, I can't just abandon Persicaria and the others here.
Reach a conclusion.

units.rawText: Perhaps I can find an opening to begin negotiations.
units.displayText: Perhaps I can find an opening to begin negotiations.

spans.text: Perhaps I can find an opening to begin negotiations.

units.rawText: [Refactor], what are the results of your diagnosis?
units.displayText: [Refactor], what are the results of your diagnosis?

spans.text: [Refactor], what are the results of your diagnosis?

units.rawText: Just as I reach my conclusion, Wisdom addresses the Lesser Sanctifier beside her.
units.displayText: Just as I reach my conclusion, Wisdom addresses the Lesser Sanctifier beside her.

spans.text: Just as I reach my conclusion, Wisdom addresses the Lesser Sanctifier beside her.

units.rawText: [Diagnostic result: Subject's neural cloud has regained consciousness. Mild infection. Subject's neural cloud firewall can withstand it normally.]
units.displayText: [Diagnostic result: Subject's neural cloud has regained consciousness. Mild infection. Subject's neural cloud firewall can withstand it normally.]

spans.text: [Diagnostic result: Subject's neural cloud has regained consciousness. Mild infection. Subject's neural cloud firewall can withstand it normally.]

units.rawText: [Refactor], analyze them again. Let nothing slip through.
units.displayText: [Refactor], analyze them again. Let nothing slip through.

spans.text: [Refactor], analyze them again. Let nothing slip through.

units.rawText: [Analysis results remain consistent. Said agent is mildly infected. Subject's neural cloud firewall can withstand it normally.]
units.displayText: [Analysis results remain consistent. Said agent is mildly infected. Subject's neural cloud firewall can withstand it normally.]

spans.text: [Analysis results remain consistent. Said agent is mildly infected. Subject's neural cloud firewall can withstand it normally.]

units.rawText: [However, targeting systems have classified the subject as an Irregular Agent.]
units.displayText: [However, targeting systems have classified the subject as an Irregular Agent.]

spans.text: [However, targeting systems have classified the subject as an Irregular Agent.]

units.rawText: The Lesser Sanctifiers aim their guns at me once more and disengage their safeties.
units.displayText: The Lesser Sanctifiers aim their guns at me once more and disengage their safeties.

spans.text: The Lesser Sanctifiers aim their guns at me once more and disengage their safeties.

units.rawText: [Irregular Agents must be cleansed.]
units.displayText: [Irregular Agents must be cleansed.]

spans.text: [Irregular Agents must be cleansed.]
Seize the initiative.
Observe silently.

units.rawText: Cease...
units.displayText: Cease...

spans.text: Cease...

units.rawText: You won't shoot.
units.displayText: You won't shoot.

spans.text: You won't shoot.

units.rawText: Cease fire.
units.displayText: Cease fire.

spans.text: Cease fire.

units.rawText: [Order received.]
units.displayText: [Order received.]

spans.text: [Order received.]

units.rawText: The Lesser Sanctifiers obey Wisdom's instructions and lower their weapons in unison.
units.displayText: The Lesser Sanctifiers obey Wisdom's instructions and lower their weapons in unison.

spans.text: The Lesser Sanctifiers obey Wisdom's instructions and lower their weapons in unison.

units.rawText: Why did you think I wouldn't shoot?
units.displayText: Why did you think I wouldn't shoot?

spans.text: Why did you think I wouldn't shoot?

units.rawText: Cease fire.
units.displayText: Cease fire.

spans.text: Cease fire.

units.rawText: Order received.
units.displayText: Order received.

spans.text: Order received.

units.rawText: The Lesser Sanctifiers obey Wisdom's instructions and simultaneously lower their weapons.
units.displayText: The Lesser Sanctifiers obey Wisdom's instructions and simultaneously lower their weapons.

spans.text: The Lesser Sanctifiers obey Wisdom's instructions and simultaneously lower their weapons.

units.rawText: You didn't react even with all those guns pointed at you.
units.displayText: You didn't react even with all those guns pointed at you.

spans.text: You didn't react even with all those guns pointed at you.

units.rawText: Were you really not afraid that I'd give the order to cleanse you?
units.displayText: Were you really not afraid that I'd give the order to cleanse you?

spans.text: Were you really not afraid that I'd give the order to cleanse you?

units.rawText: Well...
units.displayText: Well...

spans.text: Well...

units.rawText: If you were really going to cleanse me, you would have done it long ago.
units.displayText: If you were really going to cleanse me, you would have done it long ago.

spans.text: If you were really going to cleanse me, you would have done it long ago.

units.rawText: Haha, I hope you retain the same confidence as you draw your last breath.
units.displayText: Haha, I hope you retain the same confidence as you draw your last breath.

spans.text: Haha, I hope you retain the same confidence as you draw your last breath.

units.rawText: With that, Wisdom raises her sniper rifle and places its laser aiming dot on the center of my forehead.
units.displayText: With that, Wisdom raises her sniper rifle and places its laser aiming dot on the center of my forehead.

spans.text: With that, Wisdom raises her sniper rifle and places its laser aiming dot on the center of my forehead.

units.rawText: [Order received. Executing cleansing program—]
units.displayText: [Order received. Executing cleansing program—]

spans.text: [Order received. Executing cleansing program—]

units.rawText: The Lesser Sanctifiers suddenly raise the guns they had lowered, and this time I can even hear their weapons charging up...
units.displayText: The Lesser Sanctifiers suddenly raise the guns they had lowered, and this time I can even hear their weapons charging up...

spans.text: The Lesser Sanctifiers suddenly raise the guns they had lowered, and this time I can even hear their weapons charging up...

units.rawText: <size=40>Stop! Cease fire! That's not what I meant!</size>
units.displayText: Stop! Cease fire! That's not what I meant!

spans.text: Stop! Cease fire! That's not what I meant!

units.rawText: [Order received.]
units.displayText: [Order received.]

spans.text: [Order received.]

units.rawText: After Wisdom's not-very-calm order, the Lesser Sanctifiers once again lower their weapons.
units.displayText: After Wisdom's not-very-calm order, the Lesser Sanctifiers once again lower their weapons.

spans.text: After Wisdom's not-very-calm order, the Lesser Sanctifiers once again lower their weapons.

units.rawText: Whew...
units.displayText: Whew...

spans.text: Whew...

units.rawText: Although she's wearing a visor, I have the feeling that she's glaring hard at me.
units.displayText: Although she's wearing a visor, I have the feeling that she's glaring hard at me.

spans.text: Although she's wearing a visor, I have the feeling that she's glaring hard at me.
Let's talk.
Pffft...

units.rawText: Tsk.
units.displayText: Tsk.

spans.text: Tsk.

units.rawText: Why you!!
units.displayText: Why you!!

spans.text: Why you!!

units.rawText: Wisdom tries her best to maintain her composure as she approaches me. She comes to a halt, still keeping a safe distance between us.
units.displayText: Wisdom tries her best to maintain her composure as she approaches me. She comes to a halt, still keeping a safe distance between us.

spans.text: Wisdom tries her best to maintain her composure as she approaches me. She comes to a halt, still keeping a safe distance between us.

units.rawText: At some point, she considers pointing her gun at me again, but she puts it back down after raising it halfway.
units.displayText: At some point, she considers pointing her gun at me again, but she puts it back down after raising it halfway.

spans.text: At some point, she considers pointing her gun at me again, but she puts it back down after raising it halfway.

units.rawText: Good, it seems I've gained a bit of initiative here.
units.displayText: Good, it seems I've gained a bit of initiative here.

spans.text: Good, it seems I've gained a bit of initiative here.

units.rawText: Aaaaaaahhhhh, this is maddening!
units.displayText: Aaaaaaahhhhh, this is maddening!

spans.text: Aaaaaaahhhhh, this is maddening!

units.rawText: Then she tears off her visor...
units.displayText: Then she tears off her visor...

spans.text: Then she tears off her visor...

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Although we've encountered her in several battles before, Wisdom without her visor really does take me by surprise...
units.displayText: Although we've encountered her in several battles before, Wisdom without her visor really does take me by surprise...

spans.text: Although we've encountered her in several battles before, Wisdom without her visor really does take me by surprise...

units.rawText: <size=28>This is why Lord Eosphorus said we ought to equip Lesser Sanctifiers with better AIs!</size>
units.displayText: This is why Lord Eosphorus said we ought to equip Lesser Sanctifiers with better AIs!

spans.text: This is why Lord Eosphorus said we ought to equip Lesser Sanctifiers with better AIs!

units.rawText: <size=28>It's all because of these stupid tin cans! Thanks to them, I've lost the upper hand!！</size>
units.displayText: It's all because of these stupid tin cans! Thanks to them, I've lost the upper hand!！

spans.text: It's all because of these stupid tin cans! Thanks to them, I've lost the upper hand!！

units.rawText: [Warning: There is no need to reveal information about Lord Eosphorus—]
units.displayText: [Warning: There is no need to reveal information about Lord Eosphorus—]

spans.text: [Warning: There is no need to reveal information about Lord Eosphorus—]

units.rawText: Engage silent mode!
units.displayText: Engage silent mode!

spans.text: Engage silent mode!

units.rawText: "Lord Eosphorus"... If memory serves, Eucharist has also mentioned that name.
units.displayText: "Lord Eosphorus"... If memory serves, Eucharist has also mentioned that name.

spans.text: "Lord Eosphorus"... If memory serves, Eucharist has also mentioned that name.

units.rawText: From our interaction with Eucharist, it can be surmised that the Sanctifiers have internal sub-factions.
units.displayText: From our interaction with Eucharist, it can be surmised that the Sanctifiers have internal sub-factions.

spans.text: From our interaction with Eucharist, it can be surmised that the Sanctifiers have internal sub-factions.

units.rawText: Maybe the leader of the "nice" faction is this "Lord Eosphorus" that she's talking about?
units.displayText: Maybe the leader of the "nice" faction is this "Lord Eosphorus" that she's talking about?

spans.text: Maybe the leader of the "nice" faction is this "Lord Eosphorus" that she's talking about?

units.rawText: By the looks of things, this "Wisdom" must also be part of that nice faction...
units.displayText: By the looks of things, this "Wisdom" must also be part of that nice faction...

spans.text: By the looks of things, this "Wisdom" must also be part of that nice faction...

units.rawText: Ahem...
units.displayText: Ahem...

spans.text: Ahem...

units.rawText: Right, I just had them point their guns at you because I was worried that you were infected, just in case.
units.displayText: Right, I just had them point their guns at you because I was worried that you were infected, just in case.

spans.text: Right, I just had them point their guns at you because I was worried that you were infected, just in case.

units.rawText: At the moment, my neural cloud is perfectly fine. I can prove that I'm not infected.
units.displayText: At the moment, my neural cloud is perfectly fine. I can prove that I'm not infected.

spans.text: At the moment, my neural cloud is perfectly fine. I can prove that I'm not infected.

units.rawText: Fine. My name is Wisdom, an Intermediate Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Fine. My name is Wisdom, an Intermediate Sanctifier.

spans.text: Fine. My name is Wisdom, an Intermediate Sanctifier.

units.rawText: I've heard of you. You're the Professor, right? The Professor of the Oasis.
units.displayText: I've heard of you. You're the Professor, right? The Professor of the Oasis.

spans.text: I've heard of you. You're the Professor, right? The Professor of the Oasis.

units.rawText: You wear a white lab coat, have big black rings around your eyes and a sickly appearance, but still look like you can kick ass.
units.displayText: You wear a white lab coat, have big black rings around your eyes and a sickly appearance, but still look like you can kick ass.

spans.text: You wear a white lab coat, have big black rings around your eyes and a sickly appearance, but still look like you can kick ass.

options.rawText: I didn't think Eucharist would describe me like that...
options.displayText: I didn't think Eucharist would describe me like that...

spans.text: I didn't think Eucharist would describe me like that...

units.rawText: Eh!? Are you not the Professor?
units.displayText: Eh!? Are you not the Professor?

spans.text: Eh!? Are you not the Professor?

units.rawText: That... that's what Lady Eucharist told me. If it's wrong, then I must have misremembered...
units.displayText: That... that's what Lady Eucharist told me. If it's wrong, then I must have misremembered...

spans.text: That... that's what Lady Eucharist told me. If it's wrong, then I must have misremembered...

units.rawText: How did you know it was Eucharist...
units.displayText: How did you know it was Eucharist...

spans.text: How did you know it was Eucharist...

units.rawText: I remember Eucharist mentioned a "Lord Eosphorus" before. So if you've heard of me, then it's very likely that you learned about me from Eucharist.
units.displayText: I remember Eucharist mentioned a "Lord Eosphorus" before. So if you've heard of me, then it's very likely that you learned about me from Eucharist.

spans.text: I remember Eucharist mentioned a "Lord Eosphorus" before. So if you've heard of me, then it's very likely that you learned about me from Eucharist.

units.rawText: [Beepbeepbeepbeep—]
units.displayText: [Beepbeepbeepbeep—]

spans.text: [Beepbeepbeepbeep—]

units.rawText: Enter sleep mode!
units.displayText: Enter sleep mode!

spans.text: Enter sleep mode!

units.rawText: Eucharist... That cake girl.
units.displayText: Eucharist... That cake girl.

spans.text: Eucharist... That cake girl.

units.rawText: Let's get back to the point. I AM the Professor, so what would you like to discuss with me?
units.displayText: Let's get back to the point. I AM the Professor, so what would you like to discuss with me?

spans.text: Let's get back to the point. I AM the Professor, so what would you like to discuss with me?

units.rawText: Thank goodness! Looks like I didn't save the wrong person!
units.displayText: Thank goodness! Looks like I didn't save the wrong person!

spans.text: Thank goodness! Looks like I didn't save the wrong person!

units.rawText: You saved me? So you're saying you... protected us from those monsters?
units.displayText: You saved me? So you're saying you... protected us from those monsters?

spans.text: You saved me? So you're saying you... protected us from those monsters?

units.rawText: We were knocked into a coma after those monsters attacked and when we woke up, the Sanctifiers had guns trained on us. It's not a difficult guess to make.
units.displayText: We were knocked into a coma after those monsters attacked and when we woke up, the Sanctifiers had guns trained on us. It's not a difficult guess to make.

spans.text: We were knocked into a coma after those monsters attacked and when we woke up, the Sanctifiers had guns trained on us. It's not a difficult guess to make.

units.rawText: As expected of someone who earned Lady Eucharist's praise... You're right, my squad repelled the Entropics which attacked you.
units.displayText: As expected of someone who earned Lady Eucharist's praise... You're right, my squad repelled the Entropics which attacked you.

spans.text: As expected of someone who earned Lady Eucharist's praise... You're right, my squad repelled the
Entropics
which attacked you.

units.rawText: I'm not sure if I'm imagining things, but Wisdom's face seems to grow somber as she mentions them.
units.displayText: I'm not sure if I'm imagining things, but Wisdom's face seems to grow somber as she mentions them.

spans.text: I'm not sure if I'm imagining things, but Wisdom's face seems to grow somber as she mentions them.

units.rawText: Entropics? Is that what these virus monsters are called?
units.displayText: Entropics? Is that what these virus monsters are called?

spans.text: Entropics? Is that what these virus monsters are called?

units.rawText: Correct. The Entropics are evil spirits which have nested in Magrasea. Of course, you can also say they're a computer virus.
units.displayText: Correct. The Entropics are evil spirits which have nested in Magrasea. Of course, you can also say they're a computer virus.

spans.text: Correct. The Entropics are evil spirits which have nested in Magrasea. Of course, you can also say they're a computer virus.

units.rawText: Ever since the Sanctifiers were born, we have been hunting down the Entropics under the brilliant leadership of Lord Eosphorus, and we have never stopped.
units.displayText: Ever since the Sanctifiers were born, we have been hunting down the Entropics under the brilliant leadership of Lord Eosphorus, and we have never stopped.

spans.text: Ever since the Sanctifiers were born, we have been hunting down the Entropics under the brilliant leadership of Lord Eosphorus, and we have never stopped.

units.rawText: However, this is the first time I've seen the situation get this far out of control. The entire Pierides Sector has been infected.
units.displayText: However, this is the first time I've seen the situation get this far out of control. The entire Pierides Sector has been infected.

spans.text: However, this is the first time I've seen the situation get this far out of control. The entire Pierides Sector has been infected.

units.rawText: And then you decided to protect us "Irregular Agents" while suppressing these Entropics?
units.displayText: And then you decided to protect us "Irregular Agents" while suppressing these Entropics?

spans.text: And then you decided to protect us "Irregular Agents" while suppressing these Entropics?

units.rawText: Lord Eosphorus has always taught us thus—not all Irregular Agents must be destroyed; some can even be our friends.
units.displayText: Lord Eosphorus has always taught us thus—not all Irregular Agents must be destroyed; some can even be our friends.

spans.text: Lord Eosphorus has always taught us thus—not all Irregular Agents must be destroyed; some can even be our friends.

units.rawText: After all, Irregular Agents are still agents, and all agents are children of God. We were all equal once.
units.displayText: After all, Irregular Agents are still agents, and all agents are children of God. We were all equal once.

spans.text: After all, Irregular Agents are still agents, and all agents are children of God. We were all equal once.

units.rawText: After hearing this somewhat hare-brained Intermediate Sanctifier speak, I've pretty much reached a conclusion in my mind.
units.displayText: After hearing this somewhat hare-brained Intermediate Sanctifier speak, I've pretty much reached a conclusion in my mind.

spans.text: After hearing this somewhat hare-brained Intermediate Sanctifier speak, I've pretty much reached a conclusion in my mind.

units.rawText: "Wisdom" and "Eucharist" are most definitely from the "nice" faction.
units.displayText: "Wisdom" and "Eucharist" are most definitely from the "nice" faction.

spans.text: "Wisdom" and "Eucharist" are most definitely from the "nice" faction.

units.rawText: On the other hand, "Faith", "Raven" and "Angelus" might be from another faction...
units.displayText: On the other hand, "Faith", "Raven" and "Angelus" might be from another faction...

spans.text: On the other hand, "Faith", "Raven" and "Angelus" might be from another faction...

units.rawText: Still, there is something more important than the internal politics of the Sanctifiers right now...
units.displayText: Still, there is something more important than the internal politics of the Sanctifiers right now...

spans.text: Still, there is something more important than the internal politics of the Sanctifiers right now...

units.rawText: Persicaria and the others are still comatose. If I can talk Wisdom into working with me, perhaps—
units.displayText: Persicaria and the others are still comatose. If I can talk Wisdom into working with me, perhaps—

spans.text: Persicaria and the others are still comatose. If I can talk Wisdom into working with me, perhaps—

units.rawText: I trust you didn't save me just to proselytize about Eosphorus?
units.displayText: I trust you didn't save me just to proselytize about Eosphorus?

spans.text: I trust you didn't save me just to proselytize about Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: They are both Intermediate Sanctifiers, but Faith and Wisdom are very different from each other.
units.displayText: They are both Intermediate Sanctifiers, but Faith and Wisdom are very different from each other.

spans.text: They are both Intermediate Sanctifiers, but Faith and Wisdom are very different from each other.

units.rawText: Compared to Faith, who could only mechanically execute orders, Wisdom clearly has more of a personality and almost comes off as a Greater Sanctifier at times.
units.displayText: Compared to Faith, who could only mechanically execute orders, Wisdom clearly has more of a personality and almost comes off as a Greater Sanctifier at times.

spans.text: Compared to Faith, who could only mechanically execute orders, Wisdom clearly has more of a personality and almost comes off as a Greater Sanctifier at times.

units.rawText: Does that also have something to do with their faction?
units.displayText: Does that also have something to do with their faction?

spans.text: Does that also have something to do with their faction?

units.rawText: Alright then... Professor, we need your help.
units.displayText: Alright then... Professor, we need your help.

spans.text: Alright then... Professor, we need your help.

units.rawText: This time, Wisdom swiftly regains her calm.
units.displayText: This time, Wisdom swiftly regains her calm.

spans.text: This time, Wisdom swiftly regains her calm.

units.rawText: As you can see, my squad is not in good shape. This Entropic attack is unprecedented in scope.
units.displayText: As you can see, my squad is not in good shape. This Entropic attack is unprecedented in scope.

spans.text: As you can see, my squad is not in good shape. This Entropic attack is unprecedented in scope.

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower received a report from a Watchtower several hours ago, which alerted us to the invasion of the Pierides Sector launched by a small group of Entropics.

58.name: Entropics
58.description:
Grotesque-looking purplish-black monsters that are actually a kind of electronic virus, as well as the Sanctifiers' extermination targets.
 Entropics infect sectors and Agents indiscriminately. Infected Agents become carriers of the Entropy virus, and once they become comatose, their consciousness will sink to the Tertiary Level. If they do not awaken in time, their neural clouds will be devoured and taken over by the Entropy virus, turning them into Entropics.
